equal_work_definition.GA: repeat existing pure full generations; 80 requests/generation, exactly six generations
equal_work_definition.LS: repeat existing improved-LS max_iter100 and caller verification from incumbent; final real call may be truncated
equal_work_definition.VND: repeat existing VND max_iter100 from incumbent after natural return; each call reserves caller verification
equal_work_definition.termination: 480 real requests, except VND can stop at479 when remaining1 cannot start valid call
equal_work_definition.incumbent: best actually evaluated candidate always retained, including incomplete final call

analysis.uncertainty: state t intervals descriptive; instance->trajectory paired bootstrap10000 for policy differences
analysis.original_oracle: choose by original2, evaluate chosen action on independent new5; report GA/LS/VND fixed baselines
analysis.winner_consistency: tie-aware repeat best-set overlap; leave-one-repeat-out action choice on independent omitted repeat
analysis.selectors: reuse frozen original/converged scores supplied separately; no fitting on branch returns
analysis.inference: development robustness only; no new validation or confirmation claim
